v1-15.close: and made foreskins for themselves. They abandoned the holy covenant, yoked themselves to the nations, and sold themselves to do evil.

v1-27.display:
Every bridegroom took up a lament,
and the bride sitting in her bridal chamber mourned.

v1-28.display:
The earth shook over its inhabitants,
and the whole house of Jacob put on shame.

v1-38.display:
Because of them the inhabitants of Jerusalem fled,
and she became a dwelling of foreigners.
She became foreign to those born in her,
and her children abandoned her.

v1-39.display:
Her sanctuary was laid waste like a wilderness;
her festivals were turned into mourning,
her sabbaths into reproach,
and her honour into contempt.

v1-40.display:
In proportion to her glory, her dishonour multiplied,
and her exaltation was turned into mourning.
